name: Validate Dotfiles Configuration
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Shellcheck
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Setup Fish
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y fish

      - name: Setup Zsh
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y zsh

      - name: Setup GNU Stow
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y stow

      - name: Run Validation Scripts
        run: |
          # Make validation scripts executable
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-abbreviations.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-environment.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-dependencies.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-symlinks.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-shell-syntax.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-git.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh
          
          # Run all validations
          ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh

      - name: Validate Shellcheck
        run: |
          find . -name "*.sh" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | xargs shellcheck -x

      - name: Validate Fish Syntax
        run: |
          find . -name "*.fish" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | xargs fish --syntax-check

      - name: Validate Zsh Syntax
        run: |
          find . -name "*.zsh" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | xargs zsh -n

      - name: Validate Stow Symlinks
        run: |
          cd ~
          stow --verify --dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --target="$HOME" --no-folding 2>&1 || true

      - name: Validate Abbreviations
        run: |
          ./scripts/validate-abbreviations.sh

      - name: Validate Environment Files
        run: |
          ./scripts/validate-environment.sh

      - name: Validate Dependencies
        run: |
          ./scripts/validate-dependencies.sh

      - name: Validate Git Functions
        run: |
          ./scripts/validate-git.sh

      - name: Report Validation Results
        run: |
          echo "All validations completed successfully"
